Messages.Author: Coyote
Messages.Body:
This page

www.vekn.net/rulebook

And this other page

www.vekn.net/rulebook/6-vampire-sects

They refer to the Priscus block and the Paths as sects.

And the second page omits mentioning Laibon as a sect.

This can cause confusion when using abilities like Mata Hari's. If I'm not mistaken, she can't emulate a Path, nor (though this would be more complex) belong to the Priscus block.

I thjink this should be corrected.
I'm not sure if this is the right forum to discuss this. If not, my appologies.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Although it is subtle, The Prisci Block and Paths of Enlightenment are sub-sections of the Sabbat sect.

Prince of Paris, France
